profile.headline: Java Developer
profile.summary: Highly qualified IT professional with extensive experience in web, service and database stack.  Highly adaptable developer with documented success managing multiple tasks simultaneously. Providing systems analysis, requirements definition, development, testing, and support. Exemplary leadership experience with unique talent to enlist cooperation among business partners.  Effective communicator skilled in finding creative solutions and enlisting the support of other team members in meeting project and organizational goals

positions.title: Software Developer Senior Technical Specialist
positions.description:
•	Work on The National Background Investigation Services (NBIS) application as a Peraton employee.
•	Create and support AWS Lambda code for use with various NBIS data sources used in conducting background checks. Tools used in projects include SQS for xml and json message delivery.  RDS retrieval and updating of information using Postgres and DynamoDb. Event Bridge for scheduled event type Lamba’s. Use Rest API calls to various data sources and across trusted and untrusted Lambda’s.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · Java Development · Amazon S3 · Agile Methodologies · REST APIs · Teamwork · Amazon Dynamodb · Java · Cloud Computing · Cloud-Native Applications · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · AWS Lambda · AWS CloudFormation · Cloud Applications · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · SAfe Agile

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: •	Working on The National Background Investigation Services (NBIS) application for Peraton. Supported multiple applications representing the various data source locations. Supported various AWS products including Lambdas, S3, SQS, EventBridge and Cloud Formation. Created java Lambda classes that implement utility classes to communicate with API gateways using REST and to consume SQS messages from other Lambdas.
positions.insights: Skills: Java Development · Agile Methodologies · REST APIs · Teamwork · Java · Full-Stack Development · Spring Boot · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Front-end Coding · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Working in an Agile environment developing and maintaining CACI Defense Personal Property System Application. 
•	Worked with Architect team to drive application towards microservice architecture enabling the continuous delivery/deployment of large, complex dps application. 
•	Working as Lead developer for scrum team tasked with porting the legacy Rate-filing and Claims modules over to a modern JSF 2.2 architecture. Created jsf facelets, interfaces, jax-rs services, DAO’s using springs namedparameterjdbctemplate, and wrote sql or worked closely with dba’s if needed.  
•	In charge of code reviews, responsible for pushing reviewed code into sprint branch, handled merging of bi-weekly development branch changes into sprint branch and deployed code using Jenkins.
•	Collaborated with team to design, develop, test and refine deliverables. Worked closely with key stake holders, internal and external, to understand user requirements. Participated in product planning/prioritization meetings as well as end-of-sprint demos, in partnership with product owners.
•	Created a custom autocomplete tool that allowed DoD personnel to find their addresses, this replaced the existing tool that was a cause of hundreds of help desk tickets a month, which now have been reduced dramatically. This also served as a model to create additional autocomplete modules.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained CACI Defense Personal Property System (DPS) Application. 
•	Identified and reported problems in new and existing software that was targeted for Echo release.
•	Worked closely with testing team to debug and fix issues related to Echo release. 
•	Interpreted business requirements which allowed me to implemented necessary technology.
•	Worked on Kilo release building backend services to connect and persist data from Oracle database to JSF frontend. 
•	Served as lead for backend services of kilo project which is the redesign of the application responsible for allowing DoD customers to file claims for damaged items during personal property moves. In charge of building interfaces and service implementations to connect and persist data from Oracle database to JSF frontend pages. 
•	Created standard for data access objects using Spring NamedParameterJdbcTemplate, including building custom mappers and value object classes.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description: Skills: Java Development · REST APIs · Teamwork · Front-end Coding · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Sr Specialist-Applications Developer CSI Application
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained CSI’s model driven architecture processes; utilized Tibco Business Studio for XPDL creation and the required extended attributes.
•	Maintained code built on Spring and Hibernate frameworks.
•	Utilized Contivo utility to map source and target schema's, to map each element from source to target and finally to generate java files from this transformation which is then compiled for system use.
•	Utilized Maven to auto generate code, perform builds and for project management of M2E services. Source code related to M2E framework, service and associated dependent projects were stored in Subversion (SVN). 
•	Maintained service artifacts such as pom.xml, hydra.xml, hydra-contribution.xml, MasterEndPointOverrideMap.xml, DMEUrlMap.xml, and Artifact.properties. 
•	Operated Jenkins to schedule M2E bundle builds, utilized JConsole utility for examination of memory and threads.
•	Configured JMS queues for transport of service requests and responses. 
•	Utilized log4j for logging and JUnit for testing.
•	Maintained CSI's RESTful interface which supported both JSON and XML.

positions.title: Senior Analyst/Sr. Analyst-Applications Developer – EBTA Application
positions.description:
•	Lead the design, development, testing, deployment and support of EBTA 22 state EB-XML-GATEWAY application a JAVA/XML interface that allowed the merger of RMI and CMIP EB applications into one web service front door. 
•	Created wsdl’s based on T1.227 xml standard, generated java code using wsdl2Java, and wrote custom business logic.
•	Setup Oracle 7-10 tables to allow for storage of data and persistent objects. Due to performance mandates set down my federal regulatory committees the application relied heavily on multithreading which was handled with concurrent. 
•	Relied on Concurrent to handle multi-thread processing, due to federal regulatory mandates EBTA had to run with transactions times under certain guidelines or face substantial fines.
•	Set up https SOAP servers to handle ssl handshakes. Worked directly with Telco customers to help with transition to Artix/SOAP web services application and deployed into test/production environments on both Solaris and AIX servers. 
•	Designed and developed XML interface for U-verse trouble ticketing application, created wsdl’s, schemas, wrote java code base, and set up jms queues.
•	Critical team member that facilitated the design and development of the C++ to Java code port of EBTA application. 
•	Designed and developed RMI XML interface that allowed for customers unable to connect to Cmip interface a solution to creating trouble tickets manually over the phone providing both telco’s and ATT tremendous cost and time saving.
•	Created and Maintained CGI/Perl Alert Web browser to allow ATT service technicians to work trouble tickets. This allowed for ATT technicians to work tickets in real time providing improved customer support and reducing cost by allowing fewer techs to work more tickets.
•	Experience with build tools Ant and Maven and testing tools such as JUnit and SoapUI 5.2
